## Why

Describe the problem and link the issue or roadmap task.

## Changes

Explain the resulting behavior and any compatibility impact.

## Validation

List checks run and any tests you could not run.

- [ ] Documentation and relevant tutorials match the changes.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the code/assets under the project license.
- [ ] No secrets, private recordings or commercial plugin assets are included.
